notes: A song played straight from the catalogue now checks how long the audio that came back actually is: a copy that stops before the song does is swapped for the full copy behind it instead of playing a minute and going quiet.
A short copy is never kept in memory, so pressing play again, or cropping that song, uses the whole song rather than the piece that happened to arrive first.
When every copy of a song comes back short, the row says which second it ends at and offers Restart, instead of falling silent as though the song had finished.
